description: OPTIONS ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-BINARY (binary128 intermediates, §2023:8.8.1.4) — a 2014 keyword of the 2002 ARITHMETIC clause, designated OBSOLETE by the 2023 text (§2023:8.8.1.4.1 NOTE 1 / Annex F.2 item 3). PENDING: the mode is documented-unsupported at every edition that has it (COBOL0806, DataBinder — a binary128 SDIDI has no exact .NET carrier), so the row has no compiling cell; the VisitArithmeticMethod parse arm still owns the 0900 introduction edge below 2014 (the two-obligation rule's diagnostic half). Activation contract: a real standard-binary intermediate implementation.
vcr: 2014 introduction; obsolete-in-2023 (VCR row 93 / Annex F.2 item 3)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SBPROG.
OPTIONS.
